watches.name: BYOP Iceman
watches.description: Check out Robbie and Watches Review.(https://www.robbieandwatches.co.uk/single-post/maxi-case-presence-with-vintage-flair-byop-iceman-gmt) BYOP watches is paying tribute to the watches worn by the legendary Maverick and Iceman. These homage watches are being offered in LIMITED quantities with a first production run of ONLY 100 Maverick and 50 Iceman. We know when others say that's the way he flies, ice-cold, no mistakes it means he gets the job done, and it's done right. To get it right, this homage watch is crafted with the bezel design more true to the vintage watch worn by the legendary Iceman. The BYOP Iceman also features a GMT function and 24 hour rotating ceramic bezel for an additional time zone. To honor the Iceman spirit, the case back is designed with debossed artwork from Iceman's flight jacket VF-213 patch and surrounded by the words It's Not Your Flying...It's Your Attitude. CASE 40mm 316 stainless steel with screw-in crown 13mm thickness 20mm lug width 48mm lug to lug length Screw-back case with artwork Water Resistance 100M / 10ATM Dial Black with BGW9 luminescent indices and hands. Date window with magnification. Red GMT hand. CRYSTAL Sapphire with blue anti-reflective coating treatment inside. BEZEL Unidirectional rotating blue/red GMT ceramic bezel with BGW9 luminescent. BRACELET 316L stainless steel with screw links for easy size adjustmnts. Clasp with easy sliding mini-adjustments for additional sizing. MOVEMENT Seiko Automatic NH34 (41+ hours Power Reserve). INSTRUCTION MANUAL(http://byopwatches.com/iceman-instruction-manual) 1-YEAR WARRANTY(http://BYOPwatches.com/shipping-returns-warranty-privacy)

watches.name: Navigator
watches.description: Experience the freedom to navigate your own path with the Navigator by Byop Watches. This is a bold Pilot watch designed with maximum visual acuity and aviation timing functions, emphasizing navigation using cardinal points and degree orientation to the sun and time zones. The internal rotating bezel, controlled by the upper crown, accentuates navigation orientation, allowing for precise and reliable time-keeping on your adventures. Whether crossing time zones or charting new courses, Navigator puts you firmly in the pilot seat. Don’t be a passenger....Be Your Own Pilot with Byop Watches. Seiko Automatic Movement: highly regarded Seiko NH-35A automatic movement industry known for quality and robust durability. Watch Case Material: hypoallergenic, surgical grade, 316L stainless steel. Ideal Case Size: 42mm wide x 48mm lug-to-lug length x 22mm lug width - sized for modern pilot’s wrist comfort and functionality. Aviation Dial: official U.S. military aviation number fonts are used combined with bold indices that are designed with relative proportions and select pantone colors that produce maximum visual acuity for quick and accurate reading of time. Aviation Hands: same as aviation instrument dials, we chose prominent white sword style hour and minute hands with black centers provide for optimal visual contrast. The second hand is designed as a instrument styled gauge needle and is select color (white, red, yellow, orange) coded to correspond with each variant and function. Internal Rotating Bezel: upper crown - numbers and indices designed in increments for timing of seconds, minutes, and hours. Swiss Super-LumiNova triangle, numbers, and indices for timing in low-light and darkness. Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova: hands, indices, and numbers are engineered for bold night vision using one of the industry’s highest quality luminance known for its greenish colored brightness and the ability to maintain luminescent over time. Blue Anti-Reflective Coating inside of front sapphire crystal to reduce glare and reflection. Sapphire Crystals: to resist scratches or cracks, the front and back case glass use a sapphire crystal that are 1 step below a diamond in hardness. Exhibition Caseback: designed for visual display of the engineered watch movement and branded mechanical rotor. Stealth Date Window: engineered a deep-set date window with gray numerals that create a subtle display. Water Resistance: 5ATM (50 meters). Case Lug Holes: designed for easy access to springs bars for quick strap changes. Grooved Crowns: specially designed grooved edged crowns that enhance textile feel and grip. Genuine Leather Watch Strap: select top-grain leather strap with branded tapered buckle. 1-Year Warranty.

watches.name: Avi-Chrono Black
watches.description: BYOP Avi-Chrono: Precision Cockpit Instrument Design. Engineered for ultimate visual acuity in the cockpit and bulletproof reliability on the ground, the BYOP Avi-Chrono is the evolution of our signature aviation tool watch DNA. Limited to an exclusive production run of just 100 total pieces, this chronograph is built specifically for pilots and watch collectors who demand uncompromising utility and a bold, aggressive wrist presence. Customize yours with a choice between a rugged Bead-Blasted Steel finish or a stealthy Matte Black Titanium PVD coating, paired with your choice of a high-contrast Orange or Luminescent White chronograph and sub-dial second hand. White chronograph second hand. Full Technical Architecture & Specifications Case Dimensions: 41mm Diameter, 45.6 lug-to-lug, 20mm width. Case Finishes: Tactical Bead-Blasted or Heat-Treated Titanium PVD plating. Dial: Black with choice of orange or luminescent second hands. Movement: High-performance, ultra-reliable Miyota 0S00 Quartz 12 hour, 60 minutes, 60 seconds Chronograph. Crystal: Flat Sapphire Crystal with 3 internal layers of blue Anti-Reflective (AR) coating. Luminescence: Premium Swiss BGW9 on hands, sub-dials, numerals, and indices. Water Resistance: 100 Meters (10 ATM) via a secure screw-down crown and case back. Premium Integrated Steel Bracelet: Every Avi-Chrono ships on a solid-link, high-quality 316L stainless steel bracelet featuring screw links (no cheap friction pins) for effortless sizing adjustments at home. Milled Double-Button Clasp: Ditching the stamped metals common in microbrands, our custom bracelet secures via a heavy-duty, fully milled double-button clasp equipped with quick-release integration. Instrument-Grade Legibility: Features clean, oversized military-style aviation numerals and redesigned, highly prominent sub-dial tracking needles to let you measure elapsed seconds, minutes, and hours effortlessly. Scratch and Reflection Resistant Armor: Our tactical black variant undergoes a highly durable, heat-treated Titanium PVD plating process engineered to resist reflection, withstand hard bangs, vibration, and daily wear. 1-YEAR WARRANTY(http://BYOPwatches.com/shipping-returns-warranty-privacy)

watches.name: Meridian
watches.description: Take command of your journey with the Meridian from Byop Watches. This bold Pilot watch is designed with maximum visual acuity and an emphasis on a 2nd time zone function, ensuring you stay on track no matter where your adventures take you. Featuring an internal rotating bezel controlled by the upper crown, its hour numbers are crafted for a 2nd time zone, while the triangle marker offers versatile timing for hours, minutes, or seconds. The standout number 12 on the dial, along with rectangular indices and aviation pan, provides clarity and style that defines the essence of a pilot's spirit. Don't be a passenger—be your own pilot with the Meridian. Seiko Automatic Movement: highly regarded Seiko NH-35A automatic movement industry known for quality and robust durability. Watch Case Material: hypoallergenic, surgical grade, 316L stainless steel. Ideal Case Size: 42mm wide x 48mm lug-to-lug length x 22mm lug width - sized for modern pilot’s wrist comfort and functionality. Aviation Dial: official U.S. military aviation number fonts are used combined with bold indices that are designed with relative proportions and select pantone colors that produce maximum visual acuity for quick and accurate reading of time. Aviation Hands: same as aviation instrument dials, we chose prominent white sword style hour and minute hands with black centers provide for optimal visual contrast. The second hand is designed as a instrument styled gauge needle and is select color (white, red, yellow, orange) coded to correspond with each variant and function. Internal Rotating Bezel: upper crown - numbers and indices designed in increments for timing of seconds, minutes, and hours. Swiss Super-LumiNova triangle, numbers, and indices for timing in low-light and darkness. Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova: hands, indices, and numbers are engineered for bold night vision using one of the industry’s highest quality luminance known for its greenish colored brightness and the ability to maintain luminescent over time. Blue Anti-Reflective Coating inside of front sapphire crystal to reduce glare and reflection. Sapphire Crystals: to resist scratches or cracks, the front and back case glass use a sapphire crystal that are 1 step below a diamond in hardness. Exhibition Caseback: designed for visual display of the engineered watch movement and branded mechanical rotor. Water Resistance: 5ATM (50 meters). Stealth Date Window: engineered a deep-set date window with gray numerals that create a subtle display. Case Lug Holes: designed for easy access to springs bars for quick strap changes. Grooved Crowns: specially designed grooved edged crowns that enhance textile feel and grip. Genuine Leather Watch Strap: select top-grain leather strap with branded tapered buckle. 1-Year Warranty
